run_pretrain_sweep: run a ParlAI parameter sweep to pretrain TOD dialogue agents across multiple teachers
review_teacher_options: review the TEACHER_OPTIONS list to understand which TOD dataset teachers are included in the sweep
review_grid_params: review the grid dictionary to understand the hyperparameters used for pretraining TOD agents
summarize_pretrain_config: summarize the pretraining configuration including teachers, model, and hyperparameters for TOD simulation
refactor_run_grid_call: refactor the run_grid call to adjust GPU count, training hours, or memory allocation for the sweep
